name: Kongouji Katsumi
source:
Instructor at a nudist camp. She is 165 cm tall. She is an older sister.

She is quite glamorous and proud of her tanned, stocky body. She is savage, quite forceful, and masculine.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/SYG/index.html]official site[/url]]
